name: chain-master-hash

graded_by.test: vault/chain2_test.go — TestMasterHashVector: reproduces the published vector using the core implementation or independent Go test code for a browser-only step
harness/rigs/vault-vectors.sh — rig-vault-vectors: runs this vector through the deployed browser module in Chromium and requires every selected case to pass

description: Chain step 2: master_hash = argon2id(passphrase bytes, user_salt), t=3, m=64 MiB, p=4, 32 bytes, version 0x13. argon2-cffi and a browser's WASM argon2id may share the reference C code, so Go's golang.org/x/crypto/argon2 is the independent check of this step (DEFAULT 55).

implementations.what: the browser vault client (web/src/vault/); U7, the TUI, for the steps it runs
Go test code in vault/ (golang.org/x/text/secure/precis; golang.org/x/crypto/argon2)
